description.value: The Sandspit Visitor Centre is a tourism information office located at Sandspit Airport on Haida Gwaii, one of Canada's most remote and ecologically rich cycling destinations. Situated at the island's main air entry point, it serves as a first stop for travellers — including cyclists flying in with their bikes — seeking local knowledge and orientation. The centre is wheelchair accessible per OSM, and its remote island setting makes it a notable waypoint for adventure cyclists exploring the archipelago.
